title: Refund Policy
content:
Refund Policy

We consider trust in our tools and services as the highest value among our users. However, there might be times when the tools do not meet your expectations altogether. This policy will describe when refunds can be claimed, and how to go about it. These terms of use apply as soon as you access this website and start buying any tools or services available here.

Eligibility for Refunds

Refunds are available moreover under certain expectations. These involve some technical bugs that deny the tool’s working capacity as described or disparities between the service offered and what we advertise on our website. 

A refund will only be granted where the complaint has been made within 24 hours from when the tool was purchased. Any request made after this period will not be considered for a refund, except if there is a provision of law that supports such requests.

Process for Requesting a Refund

If you believe you are eligible for a refund, follow these steps:

Contact Customer Support: You can write an email to us at a given email address or fill out the form available on the website. Fill in your order number, the date when it was placed and a brief description of the problem.

Assessment of Request: A request is normally processed by our support team within 5-7 business days. At this time, you may be requested to present more details or proof regarding the problem, for example, screenshots or logs.

Approval or Denial: Once your request adheres to our refund policy terms, we will approve the refund, and the amount will be credited back to your original form of payment within the next 7 to 10 business days. In case we can reject your request we will explain why for sure.

Partial Refunds

Occasionally, partially emptying or ‘clawing back’ some of the refunds may be carried out. It usually holds where a tool or service has been partially utilized but remains unusable for a certain reason beyond the control of the customer. The refund that will be given will, therefore, depend on the degree of usage and the nature of the problem given.

Exceptions for Refunds

Refunds may not be issued under the following circumstances:

  • The customer decides to take a different view after purchase.
  • This tool or service cannot operate on unsupported platforms or systems.
  • The problem noted is resultant of third-party intervention or changes made by the customer. 

Customers are expected to:

  • It should also be compatible with their systems when purchased.
  • Abide by the installation and usage instructions provided.
  • As much as possible, report problems immediately and give satisfactory information.
  • Access the tools and services only for the purpose for which they were designed without any alteration.

Changes to This Policy

As a result, for purposes of clarity, we are entitled to alter or modify this refund policy at any time. The adjustment will be implemented when it is placed on our website. Customers are also advised to read this policy from time to time in order to acquaint themselves with the terms and conditions.
